name: asuswrt
description: Inspect and control an ASUS (AsusWRT) router from Claude Code — clients, WAN, firewall state, port forwarding, guest WiFi, WiFi security. Needs uv on PATH; it fetches Python and the dependencies on first run. It asks for the router's admin password when you install it.

router_password.title: Router admin password
router_password.description: The password for the router's web interface. Stored in this machine's secure storage and never sent to a model. Leave blank if you already keep it in ~/.config/asuswrt/.env.

router_user.title: Router admin username
router_user.description: Usually admin. Leave blank for admin.

router_host.title: Router address
router_host.description: Leave blank to use the default gateway, which is the right answer on almost every home network.

allow_writes.title: Allow changes to the router
allow_writes.description: Off: Claude can only read the router. On: it can also add port forwards, switch guest WiFi on or off, and change WiFi security — always showing a preview and asking before it applies anything.

allow_dangerous.title: Allow reboot and firmware upgrade
allow_dangerous.description: Needs the setting above as well. Adds two tools that restart the router or flash new firmware.
